# Dialectic

> Dialectic transforms organizational culture through science-backed microlearning, DEI training, and person-centered leadership development using the I2E® methodology.

Dialectic specializes in behavior change and skills training for organizations seeking to build inclusive, high-performing cultures. Their Learning Snippets platform delivers scenario-based microlearning grounded in spaced repetition science, while custom solutions leverage the I2E® (Illuminate to Elevate) methodology developed by founder Dr. Aaron Barth.

## Key Topics
